message: Cruise’s managed workers failed before the research task began, with “workspace routing discovery failed.” I’m preserving that failure record and switching the literature work to two independent Parallel research requests. Each receives only its own question and public sources, with no access to the local filesystem or the other request’s output. I’ll save each response through its own temporary workspace, then give the completed reports to a fresh consolidator. The local execution problem will remain an explicit feasibility constraint.
